summary.text: Jodi Newell is a Democratic state representative from Cheshire District 4 in the New Hampshire House of Representatives, where she has served since December 2022, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as community organizer.

paragraphs.text: Jodi Newell graduated from Weymouth High School in 1998.
Her career experience includes working as a homeless advocate with Friends of the Homeless of the South Shore and as an overdose crisis organizer with Rights & Democracy.
Newell assumed office in the New Hampshire House of Representatives on December 7, 2022, succeeding Lawrence Welkowitz.
Ballotpedia lists her as a member of the Criminal Justice and Public Safety Committee for 2023-2024.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026, and is on the November 3 ballot for Cheshire 4.
